## Heads-up

<!--
This text goes to the people using Novadeck: it becomes the Heads-up card they see after updating. Write it for someone who uses the app every day and has never seen its code.

Would someone who used this yesterday be surprised, or have to do something differently? That means a control moved or removed, or a changed key, default or layout. If so, say what they'll notice, what's gone, and what to do instead, using the names the app shows.

Otherwise write None. Most pull requests are None: anything added, a fix that restores what people expected, and every internal change. Nothing a user wouldn't care about goes here: no refactors, tests, CI, file, package or API names, or notes for contributors. Those belong in Impact.
-->
